title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28.2): Change AI models for agents in the UI
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 (BC28.2) lets agents use different AI models directly in the UI. Users can select a specific model for each agent or use automatic default selection, with a resolution order that prioritizes task-level, then agent-level, then system default models.
key_points: On the Agents page, each agent card has an Agent model section where you choose a specific model or Auto
The model chosen affects how an agent behaves, how it performs and what results it gives
Business Central picks the model in this order: the one set on the task, then the one set on the agent, then the default
Custom agents arrived in 2025 wave 2 (BC27.4); managing models in the UI is new in BC28.2 and is in preview
With Auto, the model can change over time; to get predictable behavior, pin the agent to a specific model version

quotes.text: Agents in Business Central can run on different AI models. The model an agent uses can affect its behavior, performance, and results.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core capability and why model selection matters for agent functionality

quotes.text: With this minor update (BC28.2), we can now view and manage AI models directly within the UI.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the new feature that makes model management accessible to end users
